New report — A Framework for Decomposing DeFi Risk in the Age of AI As DeFi matures and institutional capital arrives, a common language for measuring and comparing risk is becoming essential. Re7 Capital and Clear Street have jointly published a new report that proposes a framework towards an industry-wide DeFi risk standard, drawing on Re7’s risk methodology. The report covers: 🔹 Why we propose breaking DeFi risk down into three layers (chain, protocol, and asset), and how a proposed industry standard could be governed 🔹 How risks across layers can compound rather than add up, and what genuine diversification requires across the DeFi stack 🔹 Chain risk and the “1% problem”: how systematic chain selection can help manage infrastructure risk 🔹 How AI is changing the DeFi risk landscape, and how it can enable continuous monitoring across the DeFi stack Download the full report via the link 👇 https://re7.capital/blog/3b3ec006-c302-40b0-85c9-48310f1b4399
